public_health_question.v: Was a cluster of HIV infections among persons without known risk factors transmitted through platelet-rich plasma microneedling facials at an unlicensed New Mexico spa?

ev.q: NMDOH and CDC investigated cosmetic injection services as a possible transmission route for HIV.
Investigation of Presumptive HIV Transmission Associated with Receipt of Platelet-Rich Plasma Microneedling Facials at a Spa

Medical record reviews and clinician interviews were conducted for all confirmed patients. Three patients were interviewed by NMDOH.

notes: Maximum likelihood phylogenetic analysis of pol, gag and env sequences (with 46 New Mexico control sequences) establishes molecular linkage, which is part of the case definition, so it is not recorded as a procedure. Testing of 198 clients and partners found no further HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C infections.
